_comment: Read-reach mutation table (issue #113) — run it from the workspace root:
Scoped to the two suites that pin the reach, so CAUGHT means one of THEM
caught it; exit-code reporting names no individual test.
The last entry is a CONTROL that MUST be MISSED.
command: uv run pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_read_reach.py && bunx vitest run tests/js/list-refusal.test.js

mutations.label: /list?type=path no longer checks the reach (the setting alone decides)
mutations.before:
if not _within_read_roots(target):
            return None, READ_REACH_REFUSAL
        return target, ""
    return None, f"unknown type: {type_name}"
mutations.after:
return target, ""
    return None, f"unknown type: {type_name}"

mutations.label: /file streams any absolute path once the setting is on
/thumb and /metadata ?path= no longer check the reach
containment becomes a string-prefix test (/x/comfy-private passes as /x/comfy)
a relative folder_paths entry is admitted (resolves against the server cwd)
mutations.before: return [os.path.abspath(c) for c in candidates if isinstance(c, str) and os.path.isabs(c)]
mutations.after: return [os.path.abspath(c) for c in candidates if isinstance(c, str) and c]

mutations.label: registered model folders are dropped from the reach
the reach REPLACES the setting instead of narrowing it
fetchListing reports the status code instead of the backend's reason
CONTROL: docstring prose no test can see
